summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit news release dated August 6, 2026, declaring routine quarterly dividends on common and preferred shares. The common dividend is $0.96 per share, unchanged from the prior quarter, payable September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record August 26, 2026. Preferred share dividends on Series 3, 4, 5, 8R, 9QR, 10R, and 11QR were also declared. The filing includes standard dividend reinvestment plan mechanics and tax designation. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
